product_overview: Buon Appetito Port d'Andratx is an upscale Italian restaurant website that presents the brand story, showcases its food and wine offerings, and lets guests explore menus in multiple languages. It also provides a multi-step table reservation flow designed for a premium dining experience.
core_goals: Explore the restaurant homepage and learn about the brand, atmosphere, location, and reviews
Browse the digital food menu with categories, dietary indicators, and multilingual content
Browse the wine and beverage list with descriptions and pairing information
Book a table by selecting guests, date, seating preference, service time, and contact details
Switch the experience between Spanish, English, and German

features.name: Landing Page & Brand Experience
features.description: Shows the restaurant’s story, cuisine focus, location, reviews, and direct calls to explore the menu or start a reservation.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Explore the hero section -> Open the interactive circular gallery -> Read customer reviews -> View location and opening hours -> Choose to explore the menu or start a reservation
Navigate to / -> Open the mobile navigation menu -> Select a destination section or page -> See the corresponding content or page load

features.name: Digital Food Menu with Multilingual Support & Filter
features.description: Lets guests browse food categories, inspect dish details and allergens, and switch the menu language.
user_flows: Navigate to /carta -> Browse menu categories -> Open a dish category -> Inspect dish descriptions and pricing -> Toggle dietary and allergen information -> Switch the menu language
Navigate to /carta -> Browse menu categories -> Choose to reserve a table -> Go to the reservation page
Navigate to /carta -> Browse menu categories -> Return to the homepage

features.name: Bodega & Wine Cellar List
features.description: Presents the wine and beverage selection with origins, grape varieties, tasting notes, and pairing suggestions in multiple languages.
user_flows: Navigate to /vinos -> Browse wine and beverage sections -> Open a wine entry -> Inspect grape variety, origin, and pairing notes -> Switch the wine list language
Navigate to /vinos -> Browse wine and beverage sections -> Jump to reservations
Navigate to /vinos -> Browse wine and beverage sections -> Return to the homepage

features.name: Interactive Table Booking Engine
features.description: Guides guests through selecting party size, date, seating preference, service time, and contact details before confirming a reservation.
user_flows: Navigate to /reservar -> Select party size -> Select a reservation date -> Choose seating preference -> Choose lunch or dinner service -> Select an available time slot -> Fill in contact details -> Accept the policy terms -> Submit the reservation form -> See booking confirmation with summary

Navigate to /reservar -> Select party size -> Select a reservation date -> Choose seating preference -> Choose lunch or dinner service -> Select an available time slot -> Enter an invalid name, phone number, or email format -> See validation messages
Navigate to /reservar -> Switch the reservation language -> Continue entering reservation details -> Submit the reservation form -> See booking confirmation with summary

routes.description: Homepage featuring restaurant story, signature wood-fired pizzas, circular interactive gallery, reviews, and reservation CTA
Interactive digital menu showcasing antipasti, wood-fired pizzas, homemade pasta, carne, desserts, and allergen filters with i18n
Wine and beverage cellar menu featuring local Mallorca wines, prestigious Italian DOC/DOCG wines, spritz, and cocktails
Multi-step interactive table booking engine (guests, date calendar, shift/time slot, contact details, confirmation)
Alternative menu navigation and redirect view
Legal notice and company registration details
Privacy policy and data protection terms
Cookie policy and tracking consent disclosure

features.name: Interactive Table Booking Engine
features.description: Step-by-step table reservation with real-time slot selection, party size picker, calendar date picker, and contact validation
user_interactions: Select party size / number of guests (1 to 10+ persons)
Select reservation date from interactive calendar
Choose dining zone / seating preference (Terraza or Sala interior)
Choose lunch (Almuerzo) or dinner (Cena) service turn and exact time slot
Fill in personal contact details (Full Name, Phone number, Email address, Special requests/allergies)
Submit reservation form and receive visual confirmation with booking summary
Switch reservation language between Spanish, English, and German

features.name: Digital Food Menu with Multilingual Support & Filter
features.description: Comprehensive menu categorized by Starters, Pizzas, Fresh Pastas, Meat dishes, and Desserts with pricing and dietary notes
user_interactions: Navigate between menu categories (Antipasti, Pizze Tradizionali, Speciali, Pasta, Carne, Dolci)
Filter or toggle dish details and allergens
Switch language between Spanish (ES), English (EN), and German (DE)
Click reservation CTA buttons to proceed to /reservar
Click return button to go back to homepage

features.name: Bodega & Wine Cellar List
features.description: Curated selection of Italian and Mallorcan wines categorized by whites, reds, rosés, cavas, and champagne with tasting notes
user_interactions: Browse wine sections (Vinos Blancos, Vinos Tintos, Rosados, Espumosos, Cócteles y Aperitivos)
Inspect grape varieties, origins, and pairing notes
Switch wine list language (ES / EN / DE)
Navigate back to homepage or jump to reservations

features.name: Landing Page & Brand Experience
features.description: Port d'Andratx waterfront restaurant presentation with dynamic hero, wood-fired oven showcase, culinary philosophy, and interactive circular gallery
user_interactions: Explore hero section with call-to-actions ("Ver Carta", "Reservar Mesa")
Interact with 3D/circular photo gallery showcasing dishes and port atmosphere
Read verified customer reviews and Google ratings
View location map, opening hours, and address in Port d'Andratx
Open and navigate responsive mobile navigation menu
